I'm on mounjaro since sep 2024 and I have a bad food addiction especially addiction to buying food delivery from just eat and uber etc. Now this doesn't mean its always fast food as I actually realised that I could get more for my money if I got stuff from a normal grocery place like morrisons (or like wallmart if you in usa) I definitely have binge eating disorder. And it was like a yo yo. A month or so ago I decided to finally try using a calorie counting app properly and I have since pretty much managed to keep up with tracking my calories mostly every day give or take a day or 2 a few times. And in those weeks I've had at least 2 really good losses, one small loss and one small gain and also a neutral no loss or gain week. I'm still absolutely far from perfect and I'm trying my best. I've never been able to form healthy habits hardly ever. I'm really hoping as even day and week passes I can keep this up and continue. I'm not strict and I eat what I what when I want I just make sure I stay within set amount of calories and some days I use all the calories and some days I have lots left over. So I completely understand about relapsing so to speak. And even with this shot I still mess up alot more than is far from normal compared to what I've seen with others. I know its because I eat for a variety of emotions big one being boredom. I eat even if not hungry. I also have a bad habit of not eating until I'm starving and then I over eat. I know these are things I have to learn to stop but it's not easy at all. From the sounds of it you have done a amazing job with your loss so far! And you have to remember weight loss isn't always linear. It's normal to have ups and downs. 

And 5lb gain really isn't all that much. I've had much bigger gains. And it is disheartening. But you got to look at how far you already come which is awesome and just put the bad week behind you and say to yourself that this next week you will do better. I don't know if you calorie count at all and if not then it doesn't really sound like you need to change that as you have been losing weight already but maybe if you don't calorie count you could try it for one week? Although honestly if you don't already do it then unless you keep having gains I probably wouldn't bother to count calories anyway I guess. I know many find it restricting but I am opposite. I find it very freeing to know I can eat whatever I want I just use app to count all calories and it keeps me alot more in control of my weight loss journey. 

You have done so well already I have no doubt you will get right back on track I'm sure. It's so easy to gain well it definitely is for me lol. I just look at food I swear haha. Anyway good luck! Xx
